\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch6:6-30

Suppose $(M, g)$ is a Riemannian $n$-manifold, $p \in M$, and $B_\varepsilon (p)$ is a geodesic ball centered at $p$. Prove that for every $\delta $ such that $0 < \delta < \varepsilon $, \[ \operatorname {Vol}\left(\overline{B_\delta (p)}\right) = \int _0^\delta \operatorname {Area}(\partial B_r(p)) \, dr, \] where $\operatorname {Area}(\partial B_r(p))$ represents the $(n-1)$-dimensional volume of $\partial B_r(p)$ with its induced Riemannian metric. \end{exercise}
